title: Evaluating Visual Realism of AI-Generated Videos with Eye Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.38825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human evaluation of AI-generated videos has so far relied on explicit human feedback, such as judgments or ratings. While these signals capture the conclusions viewers reach, they fail to offer insights into the perception that leads to them. This paper investigates eye tracking as a complementary human evaluation signal for AI-generated videos. We conducted two Visual Turing Test (VTT) experiments with a total of 90 participants on videos generated by latest generative models, in which participants watched each video twice and then gave their feedback. Across the experiments, we collected 4,286 valid eye-tracking trials on 438 videos. Our analysis indicates that gaze patterns offer informative evaluation signals that align with explicit human feedback. Building on the findings, we propose the first computational method GazeEval to predict the perceived visual realism of AI-generated videos from eye-tracking data. It achieves 71.3% acc

translated_title: 基于眼动追踪评估AI生成视频的视觉真实感
translated_abstract: 迄今为止，对AI生成视频的人类评估一直依赖于显式的人类反馈，例如判断或评分。虽然这些信号捕捉到了观众得出的结论，但无法揭示导致这些结论背后的感知过程。本文研究将眼动追踪作为AI生成视频评估的一种补充性人类信号。我们在最新生成模型生成的视频上开展了两项视觉图灵测试（VTT）实验，共有90名参与者，每位参与者观看每个视频两次后给出反馈。在两项实验中，我们共在438个视频上收集了4,286个有效的眼动追踪试验数据。我们的分析表明，注视模式能够提供与显式人类反馈相一致且信息丰富的评估信号。基于这些发现，我们提出了首个计算方法GazeEval，用于从眼动追踪数据预测AI生成视频的感知视觉真实感，该方法达到了71.3%的准确率（原摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文首次将眼动追踪作为AI生成视频的补充性评估信号，通过视觉图灵测试实验验证了注视模式与显式反馈的一致性，并提出了首个能从眼动数据预测AI生成视频视觉真实感的计算方法GazeEval。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces eye tracking as a complementary evaluation signal for AI-generated videos and proposes GazeEval, the first computational method to predict the perceived visual realism of AI-generated videos from eye-tracking data.
